blocks.value: A variable is a named memory location holding one value at a time. Declare it before use: data_type variable_name [= value];
A constant is a memory location whose value never changes once set. Declare one with final. It can be assigned only once: final data_type variable_name = value;

final double PI = 3.14159;
final int HOURS_PER_DAY; HOURS_PER_DAY = 24;
